entities.summary: James R. Powell was an American physicist, notable – together with Gordon Danby – for his work on superconducting maglev, for which he shared the Franklin Institute "Medal 2000 for Engineering". He was a director of the MAGLEV 2000 of Florida Corporation and Danby Powell Maglev Technology Corporation.
